p.LARGE-CHANGES-ARE-EXECUTED-AS-CAMPAIGNS: This project executes large changes as **campaigns**: multi-commit work planned in a written campaign plan, executed as gated phases, resumable cold by any session.

p.PROPOSE-A-CAMPAIGN-BEFORE-TOUCHING-THE-T: When the owner commissions work that spans **more than one session or more than a handful of commits**, propose a campaign plan before touching the tree.

p.the-plan-carries-five-roles: The plan is one document carrying five roles:

p.write-the-plan-to-run-cold-lead: Write the plan so a fresh session — or a different person — executes it with no memory of the planning conversation:

facts.COLD-MANDATE-QUOTED-VERBATIM-AND-DATED: the owner's mandate quoted verbatim and dated,
facts.COLD-BASELINE-AND-EXIT-AS-EXACT-COUNTS: baseline and exit state as exact counts,
facts.COLD-FACTS-VERIFIED-AT-WRITING-TIME: current-state facts verified at writing time,
facts.COLD-DECISIONS-WITH-REJECTED-OPTIONS-AND: decisions with their rejected options and reasons,
facts.COLD-A-RUNNABLE-ACCEPTANCE-SCRIPT: and a runnable whole-campaign acceptance script.

p.WRONG-CURRENT-STATE-FACTS-ARE-THE-MOST-E: Wrong current-state facts are the most expensive class of plan bug — verify while writing.

p.PHASE-ZERO-COMMITS-NOTHING-AND-GATES-EVE: Phase 0 is spikes and probes — no commits — and it gates everything after.

p.EVERY-LATER-PHASE-ENDS-GREEN-AND-EVERY-B: Every later phase ends with the project's full gate panel green, and any phase boundary is a safe stop; the plan plus its execution ledger are the resume pointer.

facts.BOUNDARY-RUN-THE-FULL-GATE-PANEL: Run the full gate panel; the floor must be green.
facts.BOUNDARY-WRITE-THE-COMMIT-MAP-ENTRY: Write the phase's commit-map entry in the execution ledger — hashes, subjects, what each commit confirmed or falsified.
facts.BOUNDARY-REFRESH-THE-STATUS-LINE: Refresh the plan's status line ("Phase N landed, floor green, next: Phase N+1").
facts.BOUNDARY-ESCALATE-OWNER-ONLY-DECISIONS: Escalate anything only the owner can decide as a review point: OPEN, then RESOLVED with the ruling verbatim.

facts.NEVER-START-PHASE-ONE-ON-A-RED-SPIKE: Never start Phase 1 while a Phase 0 spike is red — a red spike rewrites the affected Decision first, in the plan, in place.
facts.NEVER-COMMIT-DURING-PHASE-ZERO: Never commit during Phase 0. Spikes leave findings, not tree changes.
facts.NEVER-DO-DISCOVERED-WORK-SILENTLY: Never do discovered work silently "while I was here" — it enters the phase and the ledger explicitly, or it is deferred by name.
facts.NEVER-CLOSE-A-CAMPAIGN-WITHOUT-THE-REPOR: Never close a campaign without the report checking every prediction — a campaign that skips the report learns nothing durable.
facts.NEVER-CARRY-A-DEFERRAL-OUTSIDE-THE-PLAN-: Never carry a deferral outside the plan file — the deferrals ledger is where deferrals live, and the next campaign's mandate drains from it.
